steps.text: The hand is now about 26 cm from the button, with the microwave door still visibly closed. I’ve finished the press and withdrawal motions; I’m saving the executed action sequence and its camera based target estimate in `gen.py`, then I’ll leave the live episode untouched.

steps.code:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Visual-only controller record for the live TurnOnMicrowave episode.
+
+The target was identified from the robot0_agentview_right RGB view: the right
+of the two lower microwave controls is labelled START in the eye-in-hand RGB
+view.  Its front-surface point was back-projected from the observed depth and
+camera calibration.  The arm axes were calibrated with short, low-amplitude
+motions and proprioceptive end-effector feedback.  No simulator object state,
+demonstration, or success signal was used.
+
+This file records the commands used in the live episode.  Running it submits
+those commands to the connected episode; it is not a read-only replay viewer.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+CAMERAS = [
+    "robot0_agentview_center",
+    "robot0_agentview_left",
+    "robot0_agentview_right",
+    "robot0_eye_in_hand",
+]
+RIGHT = "robot0_agentview_right"
+
+
+def back_project(obs, camera: str, u: int, v: int) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Map an observed RGB-D pixel to world coordinates using its calibration."""
+    depth = float(np.asarray(obs.depth[camera])[0, v, u])
+    calibration = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
+    K = np.asarray(calibration["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    T = np.asarray(calibration["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
+    fx, fy = K[0, 0], K[1, 1]
+    cx, cy = K[0, 2], K[1, 2]
+    p_cam = np.array(
+        [(u - cx) * depth / fx, (cy - v) * depth / fy, -depth, 1.0],
+        dtype=float,
+    )
+    return (T @ p_cam)[:3]
+
+
+def action_rows(n: int, *, dx=0.0, dy=0.0, dz=0.0) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Build open-gripper, arm-mode ee_delta rows."""
+    rows = np.zeros((n, 12), dtype=np.float64)
+    rows[:, 0] = dx
+    rows[:, 1] = dy
+    rows[:, 2] = dz
+    rows[:, 6] = -1.0  # keep the gripper open
+    rows[:, 11] = -1.0  # arm mode
+    return rows
+
+
+def run() -> None:
+    robot = Robot()
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="none")
+
+    # Visually selected center of the green START control in the right camera.
+    # The observation calibration/depth provide an auditable 3-D estimate.
+    button_world = back_project(obs, RIGHT, 194, 88)
+    eef = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][26:29], dtype=float)
+    print("estimated START surface (world):", button_world)
+    print("initial end effector (world):", eef)
+
+    # Each entry is (control steps, dx, dy, dz).  Camera images and proprio are
+    # returned after every chunk so an operator can inspect the approach.
+    # dx retreats/advances from the panel; dy moves laterally toward START;
+    # dz aligns height.  A first lateral attempt met contact, so the arm was
+    # backed away before continuing laterally.
+    plan = [
+        (10, -0.10, 0.00, 0.00),
+        (5, 0.00, 0.00, 0.10),
+        (20, 0.00, 0.00, 0.20),
+        (5, 0.00, 0.10, 0.00),
+        (10, 0.00, -0.50, 0.10),
+        (20, 0.00, -0.50, 0.20),
+        (10, -0.50, 0.00, 0.00),
+        (20, 0.00, -0.50, 0.20),
+        (15, 0.00, -0.50, 0.00),
+        (5, 0.00, -0.50, 0.00),
+        (10, 0.50, 0.00, 0.00),
+        (10, 0.30, 0.00, 0.00),
+        (5, 0.20, 0.00, 0.00),
+        # Retract well beyond the 15 cm grip-site clearance requirement.
+        (40, -0.50, 0.00, 0.00),
+    ]
+
+    for index, (steps, dx, dy, dz) in enumerate(plan, start=1):
+        result = robot.submit(
+            "ee_delta",
